propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to lens, data source, and compute function with no scattered per-metric code.
Metrics with no available data must return Unavailable state carrying non-empty reason and ISO accruing_since timestamp.
Every metric value must carry source (structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified) and confidence (high, classified) labels to segregate authoritative from classified data.
The is_authoritative helper must return False for backfill_classified source and exclude classified values from authoritative aggregations.
Registry uniqueness constraint: all metric ids in REGISTRY must be unique and every entry must have id, lens, source, and confidence fields.
New metrics can be added to the registry without modifying CLI rendering code.
